existing_tips: 'Guten Morgen' – accusative in a greeting: 'ein guter Morgen' → '(ich wünsche) einen guten Morgen'.
'Hätte gern' is the polite way to order.
'Als' (when, for single past events) is subordinating – verb goes to the end: 'Als ich Kind war, ...
'Möchte' (would like) is the polite way to express wants: 'Ich möchte einen Kaffee' – preferred over
Accusative demonstrative: 'dieser' → 'diesen' for masculine direct objects.
Splitting bills is normal in Germany – 'getrennte Rechnung' or 'getrennt zahlen'.
'Dürfte' = Konj. II of 'dürfen'; very polite request form.
möchte (would like) is polite. ich will einen Kaffee sounds blunt (literally "I want"). Say ich möch
